summary.text: Patrick Jude is the Republican candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 20, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a rematch with incumbent Democrat Dani O'Halloran.
He has worked in business and ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Jude was born in Portland, Maine, and graduated from Ellsworth High School.
He attended Clarkson and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maine at Orono in 1997.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Jude said he ran a small business in Ellsworth for more than 20 years and lives in Brewer with his wife, Jenn Morin, who was the mayor of Brewer at the time.
Jude lost the 2024 general election for District 20 to Dani O'Halloran, 51.2 percent to 48.8 percent, and he advanced from the June 9, 2026 Republican primary.

In the 2024 survey he said he wants a government that works together, listens to opposing points of view and addresses social issues such as homelessness, substance use and crime with a balanced approach that includes mental health services.
